"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Saudi Arabia is working to shut down facilitators and financial supporters of terrorism.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Because Saudi Arabia has joined the War on Terror, the American people are safer.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Three years ago, the ruler of Iraq was a sworn enemy of America.",

"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Saddam Hussein defied the international community and seventeen United Nations resolutions over twelve years.",
